name: Epic Welding and Manufacturing
old_description: Epic Welding & Mfg is a full service welding and fabrication shop located in West Fargo ND. We can take your projects from proto-type design to finished products. With over 20 years experience in the manufacturing industry our experienced staff we can handle your 1-10 piece orders or your 1-1,000 pieces; depending on what your requirements are at the time of an order.
about:
Epic Welding & Mfg operates as a full-service welding and fabrication shop in West Fargo, North Dakota. The company has accumulated over 20 years of experience in the manufacturing industry, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared in available sources.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including MIG, stick, and TIG welding; CNC plasma cutting up to 1-inch mild steel; 12-foot press brake forming; plate shearing up to 1/4-inch by 10 feet; sawing capacity to 18 by 18 inches; punching and notching; sand blasting; epoxy two-part painting via an automated Pro Mix blender; and final assembly. Work volumes span from single prototypes and 1–10 piece orders up to runs of 1,000 pieces, covering small to medium production quantities. Facility size and headcount are not specified.

Epic Welding serves industrial and agricultural customers, regularly building trailers, agricultural equipment, and pipe work. The company emphasizes custom, tailor-made fabrication for each job, working with aluminum, stainless steel, and mild steel to meet customer specifications.

The business invites prospective clients to call or visit for a tour to discuss capabilities, positioning itself as a partner that can take projects from prototype design through finished products.
